# Breaking the native check

The app validates the license in two layers. `LicenseChecker.check` is the
Java layer, `SecretVault.nativeCheckSecret` is the native layer, implemented
in C inside `libnative.so`. The native function is static (not exported) and
the library is stripped, so `FrEj` and `FrSj` cannot see it.

The RegisterNatives hook changes that: it intercepts ART's
`RegisterNatives` calls and records every registered method with its actual
address.

## 1. Arm the hook before the registrations happen

The app registers its natives at startup, in `JNI_OnLoad`. Spawn so the
hook is armed first. `Froj` for a USB/remote spawn arms RegisterNatives
and resumes before it returns (`rn` true when the hook armed). Keep the
same rizin session: the address below is valid only for this process:

```bash
$ adb shell am force-stop re.frida.minapp
$ rizin malloc://512
```

List the captures after spawn:

```text
[0x00000000]> Froj frida://spawn/usb//re.frida.minapp
{"ok":true,"result":{"action":"spawn","pid":4680,"resumed":true,"rn":true,"state":"attached"}}
[0x00000000]> FrRNj
```

Wait until the app shows `MainActivity` (this is specific to minapp here,
might vary for others) before listing, do not copy an address from an
earlier pid. Listing drains the buffer, so set the breakpoint from this
reply in the same session.

Read the current `nativeCheckSecret` address from the reply. Do not close
rizin, restart the app, or start another spawn before using it. A separate
chained command such as `rizin -c ... -c FrRNj -c Frcj` is suitable for
capturing a transcript only, its addresses must not be reused by a later
process. (as they might've changed)

```text
{"ok":true,"result":{"invocations":[
  {"className":"android.net.NetworkUtils","methods":[{"name":"bindProcessToNetworkHandle","signature":"(J)Z","address":"0x76322fa3acf0"},...]},
  {"className":"re.frida.minapp.MainActivity","methods":[{"name":"nativeGetVersion","signature":"()I","address":"0x76322f7e2150"},{"name":"nativeGreet","signature":"(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/String;","address":"0x76322f7e2180"}]},
  {"className":"re.frida.minapp.NativeLib","methods":[{"name":"nativeInit","signature":"()V","address":"0x76322f7e2200"},{"name":"processBytes","signature":"([B)I","address":"0x76322f7e2220"},{"name":"getNativeVersion","signature":"()Ljava/lang/String;","address":"0x76322f7e2250"}]},
  {"className":"re.frida.minapp.Calculator","methods":[{"name":"nativeAdd","signature":"(II)I","address":"0x76322f7e2290"},{"name":"nativeMultiply","signature":"(II)I","address":"0x76322f7e22c0"}]},
  {"className":"re.frida.minapp.secret.SecretVault","methods":[{"name":"nativeCheckSecret","signature":"(Ljava/lang/String;)Z","address":"0x76322f7e22f0"}]}],"count":5}}
```

![RegisterNatives capture](img/android_journey/rn-capture.png)

`SecretVault.nativeCheckSecret (Ljava/lang/String;)Z` at `0x76322f7e22f0`.
The listing **drains** the buffer: a later `FrRNj` returns only new
registrations. Addresses change per process, read yours from the reply.

> **Note:** arming `FrRNj on` on an already-running app catches nothing
> for libraries that loaded before, but it does catch later loads: try it
> after pressing Load Plugin.
>
> The hook intercepts the live `JNIEnv` table slot for `RegisterNatives`
> (index 215). Index 218 is `MonitorExit` and must not be hooked. The
> interceptor copies method names, signatures and addresses only. Class
> names are resolved later when listing or importing. A per-thread depth
> guard records wrapper re-entry once. Some framework registrations
> report a `null methodsPtr` warning, those are benign.

## 2. Breakpoint the checker

```text
[0x00000000]> Frbj 0x76322f7e22f0
{"ok":true,"result":{"address":"0x76322f7e22f0","bp":1}}
```

At this point the breakpoint is only armed. An immediate `Frmj` normally
contains only the agent's `agent.ready` message. No thread has hit the
breakpoint yet. Use the address captured from the **same target process**
(addresses change after a restart because of ASLR).

Type a non-empty value into the license field and press Activate License.
An empty field returns early and does not call the native checker. The
activation runs `nativeCheckSecret` on the UI thread, which hits the
breakpoint and parks the thread:

```text
[0x00000000]> Frmj
{"ok":true,"result":{"messages":[...,{"kind":"send","payload":{"type":"frida.bp","bp":1,"address":"0x76322f7e22f0","threadId":4573,"context":{}}}],"dropped":0}}
```

The `frida.bp` event carries the breakpoint id, the address and the parked
thread. `context` is intentionally empty (a full serialized context can
exceed the transport limit on arm64).

## 3. Inspect the stop

```text
[0x00000000]> FrBj 4573
{"ok":true,"result":{"threadId":4573,"bp":1,"address":"0x76322f7e22f0"}}
```

`FrBj <tid>` identifies the parked thread and the breakpoint. Note: it
does **not** return the register values: only the stop identity.

## 4. Write a register

```text
[0x00000000]> FrBj 4573 rax 0x1337
{"ok":true,"result":{"threadId":4573,"register":"rax","value":"0x1337"}}
```

The write lands on the parked thread's live context and takes effect when
the thread is continued.

![Breakpoint on the native check](img/android_journey/bp-native-check.png)

## 5. Continue

```text
[0x00000000]> Frgj 4573
{"ok":true,"result":{"resumed":true,"threadId":4573}}
```

The UI thread returns to the app and the feedback line shows the verdict.
Without a thread id, `Frgj` continues the most recently parked thread.

> **Note:** when the triggering call runs inside an `Frej` request, that
> request can time out (`"the request timed out"`). That is expected: the
> eval thread parked at the breakpoint. Continue the thread and the call
> completes.

## 6. Clean up and import

```text
[0x00000000]> Frb-j *
{"ok":true,"result":{"removed":1}}

[0x00000000]> FrRNj off
{"ok":true,"result":{"enabled":false,"cleared":0}}

[0x00000000]> Frcj
{"ok":true,"result":{"pid":4680,"state":"closed"}}
```

The `FrRNj import` command turns the captured methods into rizin
analysis classes with actual addresses, it drains the buffer, so run it while
the capture is fresh (see [Importing into analysis](importing_into_analysis.qmd)).

::: {.callout-tip}
### Try

Spawn the app, wait for MainActivity, capture the registrations, breakpoint
`nativeCheckSecret`, press Activate License, read the stop, write a
register, continue, and clean up. After `Froj` the process is already
running, so you can pause between commands.
:::
